thread:
Carmen: quick follow-up from the all-hands — can someone confirm the GA window for Optimize? I thought we landed on ‘late Q3’ but I need to sync planning for the console docs and SDK samples. @Lina @Evan :eyes:
Lina: yep, late Q3 is still target. that said we're narrowing scope for GA: core heuristics + batching/caching UI + rollout API. advanced quant/recommendations are post-GA.
Suresh: for the rollout API, should teams expect canary + smoke checks out of the box? or is that a separate eng-oncall task?
Jamie: canary and smoke checks will be built into the Console (toggleable). engineering will expose the API surface for programmatic rollouts but default Console path is self-service canary w/ health checks.
Carmen: great — can you clarify owners? who owns the canary UI vs the programmatic API? planning to assign tech writers and sample apps.
Lina: Console owner = Jamie (eng + UX), Rollout API = Suresh (serving/runtime). Product will coordinate docs + samples.
Evan: FYI infra folks, Dedicated customers get a slightly different rollout story (reserved capacity + per-tenant configs). ops team: we need a short spec for Dedicated fallback behavior. @Ops-bot can you create an issue template?
Ops-bot: Created issue #INF-489: "Dedicated fallback semantics for Optimize rollouts" — link: https://redwood.internal/INF-489
Suresh: timeline for API v1 stable: implementing core endpoints by 8/10, internal beta 8/17, public beta 9/7. those dates assume no major infra regressions.
Carmen: that public beta date is perfect. we'll aim to ship docs and two sample integrations (SDK + cURL) by 9/1 so Marketing can preview.
Jamie: note: batching defaults will be conservative (latency-first) for GA. Optimize will ship with a tunable profile selector (latency/cost/throughput) but cost-first profiles come later.
Carmen: any blockers we should flag now?
Lina: primary risk is kernel selection perf variance across GPUs for certain long-seq workloads; research is running a small perf sweep this week and we'll share results by Friday.
Evan: also SLO definition for Optimize needs buy-in — we'll propose final SLOs next Tuesday.
Carmen: thanks all — can we capture action items?
Lina: actions: (1) Jamie to publish Console canary UX spec by 7/26, (2) Suresh to open API PRs + beta plan by 8/10, (3) Research to publish perf sweep by 7/21, (4) Product/docs (Carmen) to draft doc checklist and samples plan by 8/1.
Carmen: adding those to the roadmap tracker. I'll ping owners in a follow-up thread with links and deadlines. :thumbsup:
Jamie: +1. I'll post the UX mockups once they're ready.
Suresh: ping me if you need test tenants for Dedicated behavior testing.
Evan: thanks, all. good sync.
Carmen: closing thread — will post follow-up with links. :wave:
